1.explanation: Prism’s patterns for number literals are defined in the clike and javascript language components. Both prism-clike.js and prism-clike.min.js define the generic “number” regex (which currently doesn’t allow underscores), and prism-javascript.js (and its minified counterpart) override that with a JS-specific number regex. To support numeric separators, these regexes must be updated to accept underscores between digits. Those four files are therefore the key bug files that need to be edited to fix the highlighting of numeric separators.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided screenshots, numeric literals using the new JavaScript “numeric separators” syntax (underscores in the middle of digits for readability) are not being tokenized as single number tokens by Prism. For example, “1_000_000_000_000” and “1_019_436_871.42” are broken apart at the underscores rather than being highlighted as one continuous numeric literal.
